_comment: Grant for running lex-code as a lex-os-mediated subprocess (`lex-os exec`).
filesystem: ReadWrite — Build/Refactor/Test modes write files, not just read them.
network: Full — reaches the local model (Ollama) or the OpenCode Go endpoint.
exec: Sandboxed — lex-code's own tools shell out to `lex check`/`lex test`/git.
This grant governs the ONE lex-code process lex-os spawns; it does not narrow
what lex-code's own --allow-effects capability grant already restricts inside it — the
two are independent, stacked boundaries (lex-os is the outer host-level one).
